title: great price, flimsy feeling, handy to have, easy to use
text:
great price, flimsy feeling, handy to have, easy to use. I have three similar thermometers such as this one. This one is the lowest price one of the three and also my least favorite. The one I use now has a magnet on it and is always right there on the side of my fridge when I want it. No digging through kitchen drawers to find it. This one has NO magnet. This one also feels the flimsiest, it just doesn't feel like it is built to last. But then again for the low price, it is hard to complain. This one has an on/off button. My other one automatically turns on when I open it. I was concerned about running the battery down if this model was left on but I see it does have auto shut-off.

If you want a low-priced budget instant-read thermometer, here it is. I would recommend that you spend a few dollars more and get a different one. Sorry.

This one is OK but it is going into the gift closet.
